readiness_rules.CodeReady: All applicable required code checks against frozen sanitized independent input pass; no production activation claim. Planned/unavailable/missing/not_assessed is not a pass.
readiness_rules.ReleaseReady: CodeReady plus strict formal inputs/source-gap review/publication/source-lock/build/deploy/activation and independent real-entry convergence with timing receipts.
readiness_rules.mixed_code_and_generated_pr: Both CodeReady and ReleaseReady gates apply; change classification cannot bypass real generated artifact checks.
readiness_rules.full_documentation_complete: Also require zero enabled required request and response source gaps, with valid source governance; W5 remains separate.
readiness_rules.branch_protection: Local workflow mapping is verified; actual GitHub check contexts and required-check/ruleset/operator settings are unknown until operator evidence.
readiness_rules.exceptions: No automatic waiver. Independent documented scoped review can handle unrelated historical suite failures only; never waive project gates, homepage budgets, publication strictness or completeness.
